solution.what: Read both Founders texts; 12 Nov fully decoded; [22 Nov] has 12 unread and 6 conjectured groups.
Tested the Pinckney legation code and Armstrong's THE=972 code on the open groups.
LoC Burr Conspiracy Collection: not digitised (microfilm 17,112); finding aid behind a bot check.
Found sibling Graham 2 Jan 1806 decoded with the State Department code printed in Weber 1979 pp. 419-30.
Weber 1979 is a print-disabled loan; table layout seen in search-inside only (73/74 near present/president); a bulk sweep was stopped and not used.
Graham's 2 Jan 1806 letter with Wagner's interlinear words found online: NARA T260 roll 8 (naId 221215877), frames 0006-0012.

2 Jan 1806: 57 coded runs, 614 groups, 275 distinct, each under Wagner's word (beling/transcription_2jan1806.txt). Not strictly blind: Wagner's words are on the same images; 0010-0011 read after about 40 WE023 lookups.

Weber's tables WE016-WE028 (cited, not copied) scored on the 418 usable words: WE023 383 strict and 405 lenient, the others 0-4 and 0-10; 200 shuffles per table (rerun 22 Nov with per-table seeds: WE023 best shuffle 9 strict, 42 lenient).
Held-out split of Wagner's words, no table: key from 0006-0008 gives 116 of 118 covered groups on 0009-0011 (200 permuted keys, best 13); reverse 90 of 91 (best 11).

January key and WE023 at the 18 open or conjectured numbers of the [22 Nov] extract: no value from the key, no sense from WE023; 18 distinct numbers all at 77 or below (11 of 613 January groups are) has probability about 2e-24 under the January code.
LoC Burr Conspiracy Collection (MSS14415): the November manuscripts are in one bound volume, Box 1, Reel 1 (microfilm 17,112); no item list, not digitised.

outcome.method_basis: No key and no images reached; the editors' partial decode stands.

gaps.item: group numbers of the decoded words

outcome.notes: Attempted, open. The January sibling is in Weber's WE023 but the [22 Nov] extract is not (beling/, 22 Nov 2026); next: LoC microfilm 17,112 to see the numbers Graham wrote; Lewis's key.

credits.note: 2 Jan 1806 sibling (NARA T260 roll 8) transcribed and matched to Weber's WE023; the [22 Nov] extract shown not to be in it; Burr Conspiracy Collection location (with AI agents)
